description: This Java class, OrderProductPopulator, converts ShoppingCartItem objects into OrderProduct objects, enriching them with product details, downloadable content, pricing, and attributes within the context of an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderProductPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts ShoppingCartItem objects into fully populated OrderProduct objects, including handling digital downloads, pricing, and attributes.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a ShoppingCartItem to an OrderProduct, enriching it with product details, downloads, prices, and attributes, ensuring data consistency with the given MerchantStore and language.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Overrides the method to create an OrderProduct; currently returns null, suggesting instantiation is handled elsewhere or by the superclass.

methods.name: setProductService
methods.description: Setter for injecting the ProductService dependency.

methods.name: orderProductPrice
methods.description: Constructs an OrderProductPrice based on a FinalPrice, setting various pricing details and descriptions.
